test_cases.test_case: Very long search string (200+ chars) submitted
preconditions: User is signed in and on the My Courses page
At least one course is visible in the course grid
steps: 1. Focus the Search field
2. Type a very long string (200+ characters) into the Search field
3. Press Enter or click the Search action
test_cases.expected_result: One of the following visible outcomes occurs and is presented to the tester: (a) Search submission succeeds: the search input retains the full entered string and the course grid updates to reflect matches for that long query (succeeds). OR (b) Search is blocked with an inline validation error shown indicating the search term exceeds the allowed length (is blocked / error shown). The UI must visibly show which behavior occurred (full text retained and results updated, or a visible validation message).

test_cases.test_case: Search with only special characters and emoji
preconditions: User is signed in and on the My Courses page
At least one course is visible in the course grid
steps: 1. Focus the Search field
2. Type a query consisting solely of special characters and emoji into the Search field
3. Press Enter or click the Search action
test_cases.expected_result: Search submits successfully (succeeds); the course grid is filtered using the literal characters/emoji entered. If there are no matches, a visible 'No courses found' or equivalent no-results message is displayed. No generic validation error for character content is shown.

test_cases.test_case: Search term with leading and trailing whitespace
preconditions: User is signed in and on the My Courses page
At least one course exists whose name would match the trimmed term
steps: 1. Focus the Search field
2. Type a search term with leading and trailing spaces (e.g., space + term + space) into the Search field
3. Press Enter or click the Search action
test_cases.expected_result: The UI visibly indicates whether whitespace is normalized. Preferred outcome: leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed and the search executes using the trimmed term; the search input displays the trimmed value and the course grid updates accordingly (succeeds). If trimming is not performed, the search may return no results but no validation error should be shown. The visible behavior (trimmed input or preserved whitespace) must be observable to the tester.

preconditions: On the Profile page for own account
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit profile' link to open the profile form
2. Expand the 'General' panel
3. Modify the Description field with <temporary description>
4. Click the 'Cancel' button
test_cases.expected_result: Profile form closed without saving changes and the Profile page still displays the original First name and Description.

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user cannot open Edit profile
steps: 1. Navigate to the Profile page of <student_profile>
2. Click the 'Edit profile' button/link
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or shown an authentication requirement; the profile edit form is not displayed and no edit controls are exposed.

test_cases.test_case: Logged-in student cannot edit another student's profile
steps: 1. Navigate to the Profile page of <student_B> (where <student_B> != <student_A>)
2. Observe whether an 'Edit profile' link/button is present; if present, click it
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Edit profile' link/button is not visible on <student_B> profile; if the edit URL is accessed directly, the edit form is not opened and the user remains on the profile page or is shown an access-denied message. No profile editing controls are available to <student_A> for <student_B>.

test_cases.test_case: Submit update with all required fields empty
steps: 1. Clear all required fields in the General panel (leave required fields empty)
2. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; inline validation errors appear on required fields (for example: 'First name' field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; 'Last name' field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; 'Email address' field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required). The profile is not saved and remains unchanged.

test_cases.test_case: Leave representative text field (First name) blank and attempt to save
steps: 1. Clear the 'First name' field
2. Ensure other required fields are filled with valid values
3. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First name field indicating it is required; the form does not submit and the profile is not updated.

test_cases.test_case: Leave representative dropdown (Timezone) unselected and attempt to save
steps: 1. Clear/unselect the 'Timezone' dropdown (leave as blank/unselected)
2. Ensure other required fields are filled with valid values
3. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Timezone field indicating selection is required; the form does not submit and the profile is not updated.

test_cases.test_case: Enter invalid email format and attempt to save
steps: 1. Enter <invalid email format> into the Email address field
2. Ensure other required fields are filled with valid values
3. Click 'Update profile'
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Email address field stating the value is not a valid email address (e.g., Email address field displays an error: 'Must be a valid email address'); the form does not submit and the profile is not updated.

test_cases.test_case: Very long profile description (200+ chars) saved
preconditions: User is signed in as a Student
User is on their Profile page
Profile page shows an "Edit profile" link and a Description field under the General panel
steps: 1. Click the "Edit profile" link
2. Click into the Description textarea in the General panel
3. Enter <very long string (200+ characters)> into the Description field
4. Click the "Update profile" button
test_cases.expected_result: Update profile succeeds; the Profile page shows the saved Description. If the UI truncates long descriptions, a visible truncation indicator (for example, an ellipsis) is shown on the Profile page and the full text is available in the profile edit form (i.e., no silent loss of data).

test_cases.test_case: Names with emoji and special/unicode characters are saved and displayed
preconditions: User is signed in as a Student
User is on their Profile page
Profile form's General panel contains First name and Last name fields
steps: 1. Click the "Edit profile" link
2. Click into the First name field
3. Enter <string containing emoji and special Unicode characters> into the First name field
4. Click into the Last name field
5. Enter <string containing emoji and special Unicode characters> into the Last name field
6. Click the "Update profile" button
test_cases.expected_result: Update profile succeeds; the Profile page displays the saved full name showing the entered special characters and emoji for both First name and Last name (characters appear exactly as entered or else a visible, actionable validation error is shown).

test_cases.test_case: Uploading a non-image file into User picture is rejected with an inline error
preconditions: User is signed in as a Student
User is on their Profile page
Profile form contains a User picture upload control in the User picture panel
steps: 1. Click the "Edit profile" link
2. Expand the User picture panel (if collapsed)
3. Click the control to choose/upload a new picture
4. Select <a non-image file (e.g., plain text file)> from the local filesystem
5. Click the "Update profile" button
test_cases.expected_result: File upload is blocked; an inline error message is shown near the picture upload control indicating the file type is not accepted and the profile is not updated (Profile page remains unchanged).

test_cases.test_case: Clicking Log out redirects to login and requires re-authentication
preconditions: User is on a protected page where the Log out control is available
steps: 1. Click the 'Log out' control in the application header or account menu
test_cases.expected_result: Selecting Log out terminates the current authenticated session and redirects to the login page. Access to all protected pages requires re-authentication after logout.

test_cases.test_case: Access protected page after logging out (direct navigation) is blocked
steps: 1. From an authenticated session, click the 'Log out' control
2. After logout completes, navigate directly to a known <protected page URL> (enter URL or click a bookmark)
3. Observe the page that loads
test_cases.expected_result: Browser is redirected to the Login page; the <protected page URL> content is not displayed; the user is not authenticated and must sign in to access the protected page (no protected content is accessible)

test_cases.test_case: Using browser Back after logout does not restore access to protected content
preconditions: User has visited a <protected page URL> in the current session
steps: 1. From the protected page, click the 'Log out' control
2. After logout completes, press the browser Back button once
3. Attempt to interact with the previously viewed protected page (e.g., click a link on the page or refresh the page)
4. Observe the page behavior
test_cases.expected_result: Any attempt to interact or refresh results in redirection to the Login page (protected content is not usable); the protected page is not accessible without re-authentication and no authenticated session exists

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click on Log out control
preconditions: User is on a protected page where the 'Log out' control is visible
steps: 1. Click the 'Log out' control
2. Immediately click the 'Log out' control again (within one second)
test_cases.expected_result: First logout succeeds: the user is redirected to the login page. The second click is ignored (no duplicate logout action processed); no additional redirects or errors are shown and only the login page is visible.

test_cases.test_case: Press browser Back after logout
preconditions: User is on a protected page where the 'Log out' control is visible
steps: 1. Click the 'Log out' control
2. After the app redirects to the login page, press the browser Back button once
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation back is blocked: the protected page must not become accessible after logout. The UI shows or redirects to the login page (protected content is not displayed); any attempt to interact with protected content is blocked and requires re-authentication.

test_cases.test_case: Logout in one tab then refresh protected page in another tab
preconditions: Two browser tabs are open, both showing a protected page within the same authenticated session
steps: 1. In Tab A, click the 'Log out' control
2. In Tab B, click the browser Refresh button (or click any protected action) after Tab A's logout completes
test_cases.expected_result: Logout in Tab A succeeds and the user is redirected to the login page. The refresh/action in Tab B is blocked: Tab B is redirected to the login page or shows a login prompt and protected content is not accessible without re-authentication.
